Playwright UI test confirms: clicking the Articles header link from homepage navigates to /articles.php, the US chip click navigates to ?region=US, search form submits preserving region in URL (?q=office&region=US), and the 'Browse all articles' empty-state button is clickable. Seed cleanup verified — COUNT(*) WHERE blog_id LIKE 'TEST_iter6%' = 0.

issues: Hero H1 'Editorial Articles & Buying Guides' is rendering in dark navy on the blue gradient background — low contrast. Root cause: .articles-hero sets color:#fff on the container, but the .articles-hero h1 selector (line 95 of articles.php) only sets font-size/weight/margin, no color. The global h1 styling in assets/css/style.css overrides via specificity, making the title appear dark on dark. Fix: add `color:#fff` to `.articles-hero h1` (and optionally to `.articles-hero p` for the subtitle to ensure consistency).

action_items: Fix /articles.php hero H1 contrast — add `color:#fff` to `.articles-hero h1` selector (line 95). Currently the H1 picks up the global dark heading color and is barely readable on the blue gradient. Visible in screenshot at .screenshots/articles_filtered.png.
critical_code_review_comments: articles.php lines 56-66: SQL string-concatenates $perPage and $offset into the LIMIT clause. Although both are coerced to int upstream (lines 12-13, 51), it would be safer to bind them via PDO::PARAM_INT for defense-in-depth and to prevent future drift if the validation is moved.

articles.php line 41-44 issues two extra unconditional COUNT queries on every page request to compute $totalAll and $perRegion (for chip badges). For a hub page that could be hit by crawlers, consider caching these counts (e.g., 5-min APCu / file cache keyed by table row count) — currently 3 DB round-trips per request even when only one chip badge changed.

JSON-LD ItemList on /articles.php uses $articles (the paginated 12-row slice) for itemListElement but reports numberOfItems=$total (full count). This is technically correct per schema.org but could confuse parsers; consider emitting full URLs for the page-N slice and documenting it, or adding a `view` link to the next page via additionalType.

articles.php and brand.php both fetch product.image without verifying the URL — relying on the inline onerror handler in to swap to the purple-robot fallback. If image hosting goes down for ALL rows, every card flickers before falling back. Consider a build-time validator that nullifies broken image URLs in the DB.

header.php nav-articles link (line 389) uses a plain href='articles.php' — relative URL. Works on all current pages because they live under /, but if any future page lives under /blog/, /docs/, etc., the link will break. Make it `/articles.php` (root-relative).
